title: Jigsaw Puzzle Game in Flutter
description: A beautiful, interactive Jigsaw Puzzle game in Flutter featuring custom difficulty levels, dynamic image fetching via Pexels API, and an immersive glassmorphism UI.
overview: Jigsaw Puzzle Pro is a polished, mobile-first Flutter application built with a focus on immersive aesthetics and replayability. The app leverages the GetX ecosystem for smooth state management and integrates the Pexels API so users can generate puzzles from thousands of stunning online landscapes, alongside an integrated coin and daily reward system.
features: Multiple difficulty levels (3x4, 4x5, 6x7)
Dynamic image fetching using the Pexels API
Custom puzzles using local device gallery photos
Virtual coin system with daily login rewards
Relaxing background music and interactive sound effects
Immersive glassmorphism UI with smooth animations
challenges: Implementing dynamic grid slicing for various image aspect ratios and difficulties
Managing complex application state and routing smoothly using GetX
Securing and structuring API calls to Pexels without exposing environment variables
Optimizing the performance of glassmorphism UI layers alongside puzzle drag-and-drop mechanics
learnings: GetX significantly reduces boilerplate for state management, dependency injection, and routing
Using third-party APIs like Pexels creates endless, highly engaging dynamic content for casual games
Integrating subtle audio feedback and micro-animations massively improves the overall game feel

title: Studyco. Education App
description: Studyco is a modern Flutter-based education app designed to give students easy, secure, and reliable access to study materials. It combines content discovery, offline access, secure authentication, and integrated payments into one seamless experience. The app is built with a scalable architecture using GetX and Firebase services, making it responsive, maintainable, and production-ready.
overview: Studyco is a comprehensive education application designed to enhance learning experiences through interactive content and personalized study materials.
features: Google Sign-In based authentication with Firebase Auth session management
Single-device login enforcement using unique device identifiers
Real-time account moderation (restrict/ban) via Firestore checks
Study material exploration with grid and list view options
Secure in-app PDF reading experience for educational materials
Offline download and caching of materials for internet-free access
Bookmarking system for quick access to important resources
Global cart flow for selecting premium study materials
Razorpay integration for secure checkout and payment processing
Profile management with editable academic/contact details and profile image upload
Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging with local notification handling
Modern Flutter UI with skeleton loading states and pull-to-refresh interactions
Screenshot prevention for premium/protected study content
challenges: Enforcing single-device login reliably across app restarts and authentication refresh cycles
Coordinating user restriction/ban logic in real-time without degrading UX
Securing premium educational assets while still allowing smooth in-app access
Designing stable offline download and cache behavior for large PDF content
Integrating Razorpay payment flows with robust success/failure handling
Managing notification delivery consistency across foreground, background, and terminated states
Maintaining responsive UI states while combining Firestore streams, caching, and GetX reactivity
learnings: Building production-ready authentication flows with Google Sign-In and Firebase Auth
Using Firestore for real-time user state validation and moderation controls
Implementing secure content viewing and asset-protection patterns in Flutter
Designing offline-first access using cache managers and local persistence
Integrating third-party payment gateways (Razorpay) with environment-based configuration
Structuring medium-scale Flutter applications with GetX (routing, DI, and reactive state)
Using Firebase Storage for profile/media uploads and retrieval
Improving perceived performance with skeleton loaders and smooth refresh patterns
Combining FCM and local notifications for end-to-end push engagement

title: MotionComfort
description: An Android application designed to reduce motion sickness by displaying synchronized visual cues based on real-time device motion. Built with Jetpack Compose, custom overlay rendering, and sensor-driven interactions.
overview: MotionComfort is a sensor-based Android application that helps reduce motion sickness while using a smartphone in moving vehicles. The app uses accelerometer data to generate motion-synchronized visual cues such as floating particles and horizon lines, reducing the sensory conflict between visual perception and vestibular feedback.
features: Real-time motion synchronization using device sensors
Floating particle visual cue system
Steady horizon visualization mode
Customizable cue colors
Adjustable sensitivity and cue intensity
Overlay support across applications
Foreground service for continuous tracking
Modern Jetpack Compose UI
challenges: Implementing Android overlay permissions across modern Android versions
Handling foreground service restrictions introduced in Android 14+
Creating smooth sensor-driven animations without affecting performance
Balancing visual cue responsiveness and user comfort
Managing touch-through overlays while rendering on top of other apps
learnings: Working with Android SensorManager and accelerometer data
Building foreground services with modern Android requirements
Designing reactive UIs using Jetpack Compose and StateFlow
Handling runtime permissions and system-level Android APIs
